text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ace, I saw you! You were jumping rope, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A quadruple hayabusa straight into a 
sextuple jump... Now that's quite a show!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Truly amazing & fantastic! Racing isn't 
the only thing you're a powerhouse at, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks! I'm pretty confident when it 
comes to jump rope.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've been trying out all sorts of moves 
since I was a kid. I still do them pretty 
often to build up stamina.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! Maybe that routine is the secret 
to your strength.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna give jump rope a try 
too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seriously!? In that case, we might 
be able to pull off a combo!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "What? What do you mean by combination?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There are all kinds of jump tricks for two 
people. I want to try them, but there's no 
one around who can jump as high as I do~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!! In other words, that means it's okay 
for me to run for it, right!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll do my best! I'll catch 
up to ya with everything I've got!
